# Contributing to Sandbox Repo

First off, thank you for considering contributing! It's people like you that make this project better.

## Table of Contents
- [Code of Conduct](#code-of-conduct)
- [How to Contribute](#how-to-contribute)
- [Style Guides](#style-guides)
- [Pull Request Process](#pull-request-process)

## Code of Conduct
Please read our [Code of Conduct](/home/mantit0985/sandbox-repo/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and let us know if you have any questions.

## How to Contribute

### Reporting Bugs
Use the **Bug report** issue template to report bugs. Please provide as much detail as possible, including steps to reproduce the issue.

### Suggesting Features
Use the **Feature request** issue template to suggest new features. We welcome all ideas!

### Contributing Code
1. Fork the repository.
2. Create a new branch for your feature or fix: `git checkout -b feature/my-new-feature`.
3. Make your changes and commit them with clear, descriptive messages.
4. Push to your fork and submit a Pull Request.

## Style Guides
- Follow the project's existing coding style.
- Ensure your code is well-documented and clean.
- Run any available linters or tests before submitting.

## Pull Request Process
- Ensure your PR is linked to an issue.
- Use the provided **PR Template** to describe your changes.
- Be responsive to review feedback and make necessary adjustments.
